fra.text: The Theorist is what remains of Jace after his most stubborn self carves away every part of him that disagrees, starting with the honest piece, and he sets out to build the Echoverse and lay it over the existing Multiverse.

He tells his creation Tam that he is now wholly one thing, that excising aberrations stabilizes the spell, and that Jadzi must die so he can follow her consciousness back to the origin of a Multiverse, but when he goes to kill her himself he sees a single image of himself lowering his hand and fails.

The Guildpact checks his proofs and finds the overlay is collapsing, and when Vraska and her allies come to stop him, he wipes their memories twice and then simply commands them, disabling Chandra, Garruk and Ajani.
Tam finally refuses to help any longer, and he releases another aberration, the Nihilist, who tells her she cannot win.
